europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Damage Diplomatic Missions in Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Recent Russian strikes on Kyiv resulted in a fatality and caused damage to the Dutch and Austrian embassies. The ongoing attacks highlight heightened security risks within the Ukrainian capital.

sources.headline: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies

europe_now.title: European Commission Confirms AI-Driven Cyberattack
europe_now.summary: The European Commission officially confirmed it was the target of a cyberattack that utilized artificial intelligence tools. This incident raises broader concerns regarding digital infrastructure security across European institutions.

sources.headline: EU Commission confirms it was targeted in cyberattack using AI tools

top_stories.title: Ukraine Strategy and Security Discussions
top_stories.summary: Following recent talks with Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump spoke with European leaders regarding ongoing support for Ukraine. Meanwhile, French President Emmanuel Macron urged allies to reconsider the question of NATO membership for Ukraine.

sources.headline: Macron urges Ukraine's allies to 'reopen the question' of NATO membership

top_stories.title: New EU Methane Regulations for Importers
top_stories.summary: The European Union established a compliance deadline of 2029 for oil and gas importers regarding methane checks. European authorities have ruled out granting any further delays for implementation.

sources.headline: EU gives oil and gas importers until 2029 on methane checks, rules out more delay
